scope: Explicit native scan-macro helper and opt-in stationary automatic launch through the existing scanner; no native binding, panel, slot, focus or controller-page mutation.
persistence: Account option in CouchsideDB; wait and latest macro/automatic reports in existing CouchsideGatheringScanDB. No direct SavedVariables writes by maintainer.

macro.name: Scan map
macro.creation: Explicit out-of-combat user command; rechecks slots/metadata/conflicts, verifies index/body; no automatic retries
macro.preservation: No edit/delete; exact existing macro reused with icon/text preserved; different same-name macro in either scope blocks creation

automatic.pause: Manual hover/point/motion probes, scan watch and scan off pause the session. Normal manual scan replaces active auto scan.
automatic.eligibility: Existing motion guard plus speed/status, event revision, visible minimap, real cursor outside, supported scan log and no known native panel open
automatic.cancellation: Motion/transitions, native panels, geometry/cursor/combat and setting changes discard incomplete automatic evidence
automatic.faults: Native query, cursor enable/cleanup, dropped-callback watchdog and display failures halt auto attempts for session; resume cannot bypass fault; protected-action notifications during a job or reporting Couchside and failed observer registration also stop attempts.
automatic.cleanup: Never calls cursor setter in combat. Prior native cursor state unreadable. No completed auto-job watchdog retries after failed cleanup. Cancellation during a native cursor call defers cleanup to explicit scan off outside combat or reload; no nested setter, later tooltip/query/save from cancelled job.
automatic.history: Same bounded last10 raw scans with source=automatic; quiet routine output. Status snapshots saved only on changes.

independentReview.finalResult: 113 local cases passed; final bounded review found no blocking issue after synchronous-query cancellation fix. Native acceptance pending.
independentReview.queryCancellationFix: Reviewer found nested cleanup and post-cancellation tooltip read during native query. Per-call marker and immediate generation check prevent both; test verifies one callback, no watchdog cleanup retry and explicit recovery.
